originalTitle: News live: Two more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet floods; Sydney’s first case of bird flu confirmed
content: Leaders holding roundtable on combating sexual violence State and federal leaders are holding a roundtable on combating sexual violence today in Sydney. Tanya Plibersek, the federal minister for social services, said rules around online pornography have to change and the government is “prepared to act”. She said during a press conference a moment ago: We got our under–16 social media delay. We got age verification for online pornography, we have banned deepfake nudes, we have banned nudify apps, there’s a whole range of areas where we are acting. The question now is what more should we do? What comes next? As well as talking about what we are doing in the online world, I think we have a really important opportunity today to talk about what we do in the real world to make sure that girls and boys are growing up safe, they are growing up in ways that prioritise consent and respect as they develop their first romantic relationships. Prue Car, the deputy premier of NSW, said consent education is embedded in the state’s curriculum. She added: Teachers and schools are the very forefront of this challenge as they are with every other challenge that faces society. But the answer is not going to be adding more to the curriculum. It’s about working together as a whole of society. Sydney has its first confirmed case of H5 bird flu after a greater crested tern found on the northern beaches tested positive for the virus. The New South Wales agriculture minister, Tara Moriarty, said it was time for back yard chicken and bird owners to prepare for potential impacts from the spread of the virus: Now is the time for everyone who has back yard chickens or pet birds in aviaries to take precautionary steps to ensure there are no interactions between their chooks and pets with wild birds. Moriarty also urged other pet owners to take precautions: The government also recommends people be careful with their dogs when walking on beaches or parks and ensure they don’t eat carcasses or chase wild birds. There is low risk of exposure but it’s important to minimise any risk for your pets. Federal government data published Thursday states the tern was found at Warriewood on 28 August. Greater crested terns have been heavily affected by the deadly strain since it arrived on the Australian mainland in June. Most cases detected in NSW so far have been in greater crested terns on the state’s south coast. The state government said a greater crested tern at Port Kembla and a Hutton’s shearwater at Corindi, north of Coffs Harbour, had also tested positive for the virus. Anyone who sees sick or dead wild birds, domestic birds, marine mammals or other wildlife in NSW should report it online or via the emergency animal disease hotline on 1800 675 888. Canavan stands by remarks about ‘feminisation’ of school curriculums The Nationals leader, Matt Canavan, is standing by his comments that a “feminisation” of school curriculums has led to the rise of the “manosphere”. The Australian Education Union called those remarks a “fundamentally incorrect portrayal” of Australia’s education system. In response to that criticism, Canavan said recently: Many, it’s not all, it’s not all, but many young boys are being attracted to these toxic voices. I don’t think it’s because there’s some conspiracy that Facebook is pushing this stuff. They are being attracted to it because we’re not treating boys with respect in the classroom. BoM forecasts strongest El Niño on record The growing El Niño weather phenomenon to Australia’s east is already breaking heat records, with forecasts showing it will likely easily surpass previous events, according to Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology. Separate research suggests climate change has greatly shortened the odds of the event hitting record extremes. In an update this week, the Bureau of Meteorology said the El Niño was now forecast to peak in late spring or summer and “reach levels above the warmest observed since reliable records began in 1950”. Read more: Should Australia be worried about the bond market? Bonds are supposed to be safe and boring. Which means when bond markets are getting exciting, you can bet that something big is going down in the global economy and the world of finance. Australia’s 10-year interest rate on government debt has jumped past 5.2% – the highest in more than 15 years. And it’s happening around the world. So what’s going on? And why should you care? Kyrgios accepts one-month ban for cocaine use Nick Kyrgios has entered a treatment program after accepting a one-month ban for testing positive to cocaine. After admitting his “huge mistake” when initially suspended for failing a drugs test on 22 June at an ATP 250 tournament in Spain, Kyrgios is allowed to compete again from Friday. Kyrgios, who had been provisionally suspended since 4 August, had faced a ban ranging from a baseline three-month period to up to four years. The 2022 Wimbledon finalist also forfeited the 6,570 euros he won in Mallorca for losing in the first round to countryman Adam Walton. But his suspension was reduced for agreeing to enter a treatment program. “I recently failed a drug test in Mallorca after testing positive for cocaine,” Kyrgios posted on Instagram last month. I made a huge mistake and I take full responsibility for it. Remembering Gloria Steinem: ‘She’s a hero to all women’ In case you missed the news overnight, we have an obituary for the late, great Gloria Steinem. Steinem was a groundbreaking campaigner for women everywhere who brought the feminist perspective to the mainstream. She was 92. Public trust in politicians drops amid voter cynicism Four in five Australians believe governments should deliver social services directly but a majority no longer think politicians serve their interests, AAP reports. chineseTitle: 现场新闻：又有两名澳大利亚人在尼泊尔-西藏洪水中确认安全；悉尼首例禽流感确诊病例
chineseContent: 领导人举行打击性暴力圆桌会议 州和联邦领导人今天在悉尼举行打击性暴力圆桌会议。联邦社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 表示，有关网络色情的规定必须改变，政府“准备采取行动”。她在不久前的新闻发布会上说：我们 16 岁以下的社交媒体出现了延迟。我们对在线色情内容进行了年龄验证，我们禁止了深度伪造裸体，我们禁止了裸体应用程序，我们正在采取行动的领域非常广泛。现在的问题是我们还应该做什么？接下来会发生什么？除了谈论我们在网络世界中所做的事情之外，我认为我们今天有一个非常重要的机会来谈论我们在现实世界中所做的事情，以确保女孩和男孩安全成长，他们在发展第一次恋爱关系时以同意和尊重为优先的方式成长。新南威尔士州副州长普鲁·卡表示，同意教育已纳入该州的课程中。她补充道：教师和学校是应对这一挑战的最前线，就像他们面对社会面临的所有其他挑战一样。但答案并不是在课程中增加更多内容。这是整个社会的共同努力。悉尼出现首例 H5 禽流感确诊病例，此前在北部海滩发现一只大凤头燕鸥病毒检测呈阳性。新南威尔士州农业部长塔拉·莫里亚蒂（Tara Moriarty）表示，现在是后院鸡和鸟类主人为病毒传播的潜在影响做好准备的时候了：现在是每个在后院养鸡或在鸟舍养宠物鸟的人采取预防措施的时候了，以确保他们的鸡和宠物与野鸟之间不会发生相互作用。中号
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
